purpose: Qualify MPS active-thread caps for continuous Qwen2.5-1.5B prefill overlap when a full Qwen unit does not fit the 25 ms S0 quiet window.

qualification_gate.selection_rule: Among configurations passing both RAN gates in both runs, choose the highest mean Qwen throughput; otherwise fall back to S0 or reject this workload contract.

interpretation_limit: MPS caps do not bound HBM bandwidth or launch blocking; any passing cap remains a workload-specific statistical SLO.
